correctness.rationale: Full proof: count avoiding words F_{k+3}-1; characterize F_{k-1} surplus and deficit states, force every compensating directed path to have at least k-2 edges, construct paths of precisely k-2 between every source/sink pair and obtain connected Eulerian multigraph. This yields an unrestricted optimal cyclic covering for all integers k>=3. Independent standard-library factor checks for k=3..16 confirm constructions but are not used as an infinite proof.
